content:
incident-bot: ALERT — runtime-gateway (us-east-1) p99 latency > 5s and 5xx spike (error-rate ~7%) starting 2m ago :rotating_light:

luis: paging oncall — looks correlated with canary deploy 202bc1 rolled out ~3m ago. seeing increased client timeouts and gateway 504s.

tara: oncall here, grabbing it. can someone post the canary id and the deploy manifest?

alex: canary 202bc1, image: registry.redwood/runtime:202bc1, rollout to canary fraction 10%. commit message: "kv-cache tweak + batching change"

nina: seeing similar in eu-west-1 but much smaller. primarily us-east-1 latency and backend 502/504.

luis: quick metrics snapshot — metrics link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/rtg/runtime-gateway?orgId=1&var-region=us-east-1

alex: logs (excerpt):
```
2024-11-22T14:12:05Z ERROR backend/req.go:213 request timeout waiting on kvcache (key=embed_cache) duration=3142ms
2024-11-22T14:12:06Z WARN gateway/proxy.go:98 slow upstream call service=runtime_seq latency=4807ms
2024-11-22T14:12:07Z ERROR gateway/handler.go:312 write tcp 10.0.1.12:443->...: i/o timeout
```

tara: initial hypothesis — kv cache change in 202bc1 introduced lock contention under certain token distributions causing head-of-line stalls.

luis: can we triage by routing traffic off the canary? maybe route 100% to previous stable (202a7f) while we confirm?

alex: agree. proposing quick mitigation: 1) scale up runtime-gateway local pool in us-east-1 x2, 2) route traffic to stable until root cause confirmed, 3) if fast rollback available, initiate.

nina: scaling may help but if it's a code-level kv lock we'll still see tail latency on some requests. rollback is safest for customer impact.

tara: executing route override now — /infra route set runtime-gateway us-east-1 target=202a7f
deploy-bot: Command received: route override runtime-gateway region=us-east-1 target=202a7f by tara. Applying...

deploy-bot: Route update complete. Rolling canary back to 0% in us-east-1.

luis: traffic switch looks applied. watching p95/p99...

sre-bot: p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 480ms in 45s. p99 dropped from 5.4s -> 620ms. 5xx rate down to 0.9% :thumbsup:

alex: nice. rolling full rollback to stable: /deploy rollback svc=runtime commit=202a7f reason="p99 latency regression"

deploy-bot: Rollback started for service=runtime to commit=202a7f. Syncing replicas...

julie: FYI support flagged multiple customer incidents (CS-1127, CS-1130) complaining about request timeouts. I've opened a customer-impact doc.

support-bot: Added incident tags to CS tickets and notified customers A and B. Suggested message draft in #support-drafts.

luis: can we get a short blurb for status page?

tara: status: Partial outage in us-east-1 for runtime inference — returning to normal after rollback. No data loss. Root cause under investigation. ETA for update: 30m.

alex: rolling health checks show steady improvement. link to realtime: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/rtg?range=5m
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All runtime pods in us-east-1 now at commit=202a7f.

nina: confirming via quick correctness smoke — sample inference calls OK.

luis: handing off to @nina for follow-up and RCA. Next steps for oncall: continue to monitor p99 for 2 hours, review kv-cache code changes in 202bc1, run stress harness with our token distribution, coordinate postmortem.

nina: taking over. I'll run the stress test and open a postmortem ticket. tagging @alex to assist with kvcache theory.

tara: leaving oncall, good handoff. logs/trace ids to look at: trace ids 0a1b2c3d-4, 0a1b2c3d-7.

julie: I'll sync with support to update customers and post a status page update once RCAs ready.

luis: quick note: backup plan if rollback hadn't resolved — enable aggressive circuit breaker config:
```
service.runtime.circuit_breaker: {error_threshold: 3, window_ms: 10000, cooldown_ms: 30000}
```
and temporary qps throttle per-customer.

nina: thanks. leaving a checklist in the postmortem doc: triage timeline, deploy diff, test harness output, mitigations tried, customer impact, follow-ups.

support-bot: Customers notified via status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2045678901

luis: good work team. we'll keep the thread open for the RCA notes. :eyes:
